verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a packaging/instruction-format standard (SKILL.md files, directories of scripts/resources) that gives agents like Claude Code or the Claude API new capabilities — it is not itself a service that exposes an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Evidence only shows Claude Code acting as an MCP *client* (connecting to external MCP servers) and plugins that may *bundle* MCP servers, which is the client-side capability, not Skills serving as an MCP endpoint — a category mismatch for this axis.
